variants.headline: Not good enough when people are hungry
variants.body: People in {colony} are hungry. There is not enough food. Whatever the argument, nobody can eat a speech. Our verdict: {target} failed.

variants.headline: Answer for the food failure
variants.body: There is not enough food in {colony}, and people are hungry. A polished explanation is no substitute for something to eat. Our verdict: {target} failed.

variants.headline: Who answers for the missing meal?
variants.body: Food is short in {colony}. People are hungry. The grandest vision of a new life still needs room for a meal. Our verdict: {target} failed.
